title: Responsive SaaS Landing Page with Chinese Localization
role: Landing page design and front-end development (AI-assisted)
description: Self-initiated concept website for LoopNote, a fictional meeting productivity product. Designed and built a responsive HTML/CSS/JavaScript landing page with English and Simplified Chinese content, three preset meetings, task controls, pricing dialogs and FAQ. Includes editable source, copy documents, browser checks at 375–1440px and a separate simulated client revision. AI-assisted work; no live SaaS service, signup, payment or integrations. No real client or business-result claims.
